title: The Computer Chronicles - The Internet (1993)
summary: A 1993 episode of The Computer Chronicles on the early Internet, with guests including Howard Rheingold discussing online community. It is a window into how the internet was seen and what hardware was in use at the time.
why: Cited as period footage for how people thought about the early internet and 90s computing.
